thermodynamic_settings.title: Thermodynamic & Enthalpy Deadbands
thermodynamic_settings.description: Adjust minimum enthalpy advantage and temperature deadbands for window recommendations.

data_description.min_enthalpy_delta: Total energy advantage (sensible + latent) required before recommending open windows. Default: 1.2 BTU/lb. Higher (1.5-2.0): Conservative; only opens when outside is significantly cooler and drier. Lower (0.6-1.0): Aggressive; opens with minor cooling advantages.
data_description.max_dew_point: Absolute outdoor moisture ceiling allowed for ventilation. Default: 58.0°F. Higher (60-65°F): Tolerates higher humidity, but may introduce indoor clamminess. Lower (50-55°F): Stricter humidity control; keeps indoor air crisp and dry.
data_description.open_temp_margin: Temperature above active cooling setpoint before open window recommendation triggers. Default: 1.0°F. Higher (1.5-2.5°F): Delays opening until room warms up further. Lower (0.5-0.8°F): Prompts opening earlier as indoor temperature begins to drift.
data_description.close_temp_margin: Hysteresis deadband below target setpoint before calling to close windows. Default: 0.2°F. Higher (0.4-0.8°F): Allows deeper free overcooling to store thermal mass. Lower (0.0-0.2°F): Closes promptly upon reaching target to avoid chilly drafts.

veto_settings.title: Hazard Safety & Dwell Limits
veto_settings.description: Configure safety thresholds for precipitation, high wind, and minimum open window dwell duration.

data_description.open_dwell_minutes: Anti-flapping latch time. Once open windows are recommended, this recommendation is held for at least this duration. Default: 45 min. Higher (60-90 min): Minimizes notification flapping. Lower (15-30 min): Reacts quicker to rapidly changing weather.
data_description.forecast_lookahead_minutes: Forward forecast window scanned for upcoming rain, wind, or adverse conditions. Default: 60 min. Higher (90-120 min): More predictive; suppresses opening if storms approach later. Lower (30-45 min): Focuses solely on immediate conditions.
data_description.high_wind_speed: Maximum sustained wind speed before closing windows for safety. Default: 18.0 mph. Higher (20-25 mph): Permits ventilation in breezier conditions. Lower (12-15 mph): Closes windows in gentle breezes to prevent drafts or door slamming.
data_description.high_wind_gust: Maximum peak wind gust speed that immediately triggers a window close veto. Default: 25.0 mph. Higher (30-35 mph): Tolerates occasional gusty conditions. Lower (18-20 mph): Instantly locks windows closed upon any sudden gust.
data_description.max_precipitation_probability: Forecast rain probability that triggers an automatic close veto. Default: 25.0%. Higher (35-45%): Tolerates slight chances of precipitation. Lower (10-15%): Strict rain protection; vetoes opening at any slight hint of rain.

circulation_settings.title: Convective Circulation Guardrails
circulation_settings.description: Configure temperature differential requirements, runtime limits, and stall detection for attic/basement convective cooling/heating.

data_description.upstairs_circ_enabled: Automates HVAC fan circulation between Upstairs and Attic when thermal conditions are favorable. Requires attic temperature sensor.
data_description.downstairs_circ_enabled: Automates HVAC fan circulation between Downstairs and Basement to harvest earth-cooled basement air. Requires basement temperature sensor.
data_description.circulation_delta_threshold: Minimum temperature difference between living space and thermal reservoir (attic/basement) needed to start fan. Default: 4.0°F. Higher (5-6°F): Runs only during strong temperature splits for maximum heat transfer per watt. Lower (2.5-3°F): Runs more frequently with smaller differences.
data_description.circulation_min_minutes: Anti-short-cycle duration. Fan runs for at least this duration once started. Default: 15 min. Higher (20-30 min): Protects blower motor from frequent cycling. Lower (10 min): Allows faster shutoff if reservoir depletes.
data_description.circulation_max_minutes: Maximum continuous run time for a single circulation cycle. Default: 120 min. Higher (150-180 min): Allows extended circulation during long heatwaves. Lower (60-90 min): Prevents running if reservoir temperatures equalize.
data_description.circulation_stall_margin: Thermal effectiveness check. After 20 minutes, if temperature change lags behind building model by this margin, cycle is flagged as stalled. Default: 0.2°F. Higher (0.3-0.4°F): Stricter; quickly stops ineffective circulation. Lower (0.1°F): More patient with heavy thermal mass.
data_description.circulation_lockout_hours: Cooldown lockout period after a stalled run or maximum runtime, allowing the thermal reservoir to recharge. Default: 1 hour. Higher (2-3 hrs): Gives attic/basement more time to re-establish thermal separation. Lower (1 hr): Retries circulation sooner.
